relationships.subject: complement component C5a
relationships.evidence_quote: Complement component C5a, also elevated in active disease, has also been shown to cause BBB permeability in an in vitro model and endothelial cell apoptosis in vivo in MRL/lpr lupus-prone mice [197].

relationships.subject: matrix metalloproteinases
relationships.evidence_quote: Matrix metalloproteinases, which are upregulated by proinflammatory cytokines and degrade extracellular matrix proteins, contribute to BBB permeability.

relationships.subject: S100B
relationships.evidence_quote: Overproduction of S100B has been shown to promote BBB permeability as well as neuronal loss [154].

relationships.subject: sleep restriction
relationships.evidence_quote: chronic sleep restriction was associated with decreased expression of tight junction proteins including claudin-5, ZO-2, and occludin and loss of BBB integrity [172]

key_findings: Review: BBB disruption allows brain-reactive autoantibodies into the CNS and is a key event initiating neuropsychiatric lupus.
Mediators of BBB permeability in NPSLE include C5a, MMPs, TWEAK and S100B.
